summary.text: Gregg Hull is the Republican nominee for governor. A small-business owner, he was elected Mayor of Rio Rancho in 2014 and re-elected in 2018 and 2022, becoming the city's longest-serving mayor, and left office in April 2026.

paragraphs.text: Has lived in New Mexico for more than 35 years; started and operated two businesses before entering public service.
Elected Mayor of Rio Rancho in 2014 and re-elected in 2018 and 2022; announced in November 2025 he would not seek a fourth term.
